description: DENA Verteilnetzstudie is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Distribution network datasets > For distributed renewables", published or maintained by dena.de (publisher inferred from the link). DENA Verteilnetzstudie, German Energy Agency (DENA), 2012, considers up to 82% renewable electricity in 2030 BMWi Verteilernetzstudie, German Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy, 2014. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support electricity distribution network inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
